question: Each GSM has 3 runs under one SRX: one of about 17-18 M spots and two small ones (0.3-1.2 M). Are the small runs top-ups of the same library?
proposed_answer: Yes: same SRX/BioSample, so merged into one sample each (12 runs -> 4 samples).
